content:
marta_csm: Quick heads-up — Northforge started rolling out two additional squads (Analytics + Content Moderation) this morning. We're already seeing an increase in both requests and embedding jobs.

jordan_cs: Numbers?

marta_csm: 1h spike: qps baseline 90 -> 310, tokens/hr 12k -> 58k, embed jobs/hr 20 -> 140. Link to usage heatmap: https://console.redwood.com/customers/northforge/usage/heatmap

finn_eng: That's significant. Any 5xxs or dropped requests?

marta_csm: No 5xxs. We do have elevated tail latency on conversational route (p95 210ms -> 720ms). Mobile UX team reported slow autocomplete.

priya_se: Two quick mitigations: 1) enable request-level routing to provisioned pool for the moderation route, 2) turn on prefix KV caching for analytics which have repetitive queries. I can push a recommended config.

jordan_cs: Also: their annual renewal is in 9 weeks. This could be a neat upsell if we stabilize perf quickly. If latency persists, they'll likely pause rollouts and that becomes a renewal risk.

billing-bot: Billing projection: projected monthly spend based on current trend -> $28.9k (previous $7.6k). Contact CSM to adjust quotas or cap alerts.

northforge-pm: (joined) Appreciate the notice. We're phasing the rollout across regions; can we get a short triage call today? Prefer afternoon CET.

finn_eng: I can run a targeted canary that routes moderation traffic to a small dedicated cluster (1xA10). If we batch embeddings and bump batch window to 40ms, we should see p95 drop below 250ms for those routes.

priya_se: Sample config snippet I'm proposing to share with Northforge SEs:

```
routing:
  moderation: dedicated_pool: small
  analytics: prefer_batched_workers
batching:
  max_latency_ms: 40
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  burst_mode: enabled
```

jordan_cs: Action items: (1) finn to run canary and drop results here within 3h, (2) priya to send the config & a short why/how doc, (3) marta schedule enablement + renewal sync with accounts team. I'll join the call.

marta_csm: I'll schedule for 1530 CET and include technical + PM stakeholders. Also capturing feedback about their rollout plan to include in renewal briefing.

billing-bot: Quota change request: CSMs can request temporary quota bump of +2x until next Monday — approve if SE confirms canary.

finn_eng: Canary started. Will report perf deltas and sample traces here.

northforge-pm: Thanks, team. We'll hold further region launches until after the call.

marta_csm: Noted. This is a high-probability expansion signal if we can keep p95 in check. If we can't, mark renewal as "watch" and prepare contingency (temporary throttles + rollout pause).

finn_eng: Canary logs: p95 moderation route -> 230ms (from 720ms), embeddings throughput sustained at 120rps with batching. Posting snapshot: https://s3.redwood.com/canaries/northforge/1766009999/snapshot.json :white_check_mark:
